figures.caption: Figure 3: Overview of FlowGDA. FlowGDA models gradual domain transport with source-to-left and left-to-right velocity fields, enforces semantic consistency using a fixed source classifier, and trains sequentially over domain pairs with curriculum-based two-stage optimization.
Table 1: Target-domain accuracy (%) on four GDA benchmarks; ”N/A” means not reported.
